subtitle: The Human Learns Too

slots.anchor: For a while the edits became objectively more polished and subjectively worse.
slots.brief: Margin vignette: a manuscript page being polished by a mechanical burnisher until the words go featureless and shiny; a hand reaching in to stop it, pencil corrections crowding the margin (illegible squiggles, not readable text).
Corner scene: a traveler slumped at an airport gate at 4:20 a.m., three boarding passes fanned in hand, visa queue behind, one tiny triumphant receipt fluttering. The cost of the literal objective.

Margin vignette: a child building a tower inside a wooden scaffold; an adult quietly removing scaffold pieces from the parts the child has mastered, adding one where they reach beyond themselves. The scaffold is temporary and that is its point.

slots.anchor: AI can make the map cheap.
slots.brief: Small spot: a hiker holding a beautiful, freshly printed map so large it hides the mountain in front of them; a scarred old signpost points the other way. No readable text.

slots.anchor: ## Some Choices Change the Person Choosing
slots.brief: Corner scene: a freestanding door on open terrain; the figure approaching it and the figure leaving on the far side are recognizably the same person, dressed and standing differently. The door casts both shadows.
